from datetime import datetime

# Ensure we have a spotify access token
try:
    token
except NameError:
    # login
    spotify_pw=None
    for a in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
        if a['account_name']=='spotify':
            spotify_pw=a['password']
            break
    login_resp = apis.spotify.login(username='caiburc@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
    token = login_resp['access_token']

current_year = datetime.now().year
print('current_year', current_year)

# Fetch ALL recommendations (paginate)
recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('recs_page', page_index, 'len', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    recs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1

unique_song_ids = sorted({r['song_id'] for r in recs})
print('unique_recommended_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

# Filter to R&B songs released in the current year
selected=[]
for sid in unique_song_ids:
    s = apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    release_date = s.get('release_date')
    genre = s.get('genre')
    # Parse year from release_date
    rel_year = None
    if release_date:
        try:
            rel_year = datetime.fromisoformat(release_date).year
        except Exception:
            # fallback split
            rel_year = int(str(release_date)[:4])
    is_rnb = (genre == 'R&B') or (isinstance(genre,str) and 'R&B' in genre)
    in_year = (rel_year == current_year)
    if is_rnb and in_year:
        selected.append({'song_id': sid, 'title': s.get('title'), 'release_date': release_date, 'genre': genre})

print('selected_count', len(selected))
print('selected_song_ids', [x['song_id'] for x in selected])
print('selected_titles', [x['title'] for x in selected])

from datetime import datetime

current_year=datetime.now().year
selected_song_ids=[87,184]
for sid in selected_song_ids:
    s=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    print('song_id',sid,'title',s['title'],'genre',s.get('genre'),'release_date',s.get('release_date'))

# create new playlist
create_resp=apis.spotify.create_playlist(title='R&B Recommendation', access_token=token, is_public=False)
print('create_playlist_resp',create_resp)
playlist_id=create_resp['playlist_id']

# add songs
for sid in selected_song_ids:
    r=apis.spotify.add_song_to_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, song_id=sid, access_token=token)
    print('added',sid,'resp',r)

# verify
pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=playlist_id, access_token=token)
print('playlist_title',pl.get('title'),'song_count',len(pl.get('songs',[])))
print('playlist_song_ids',[x['id'] for x in pl.get('songs',[])])
